item.title: DigitsOnTurbo accepted at ASPLOS 2027
item.description: Our work “DigitsOnTurbo: Leveraging SIMD for Accelerating Large-number Arithmetic” has been accepted at the 32nd ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS), April 2027.
